=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:24184-24223 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: Both release paths call `_security_dependency_clear_latch` (lines 18807-18831) only when the release marker is missing (line 24188 for unmerged, line 24213 for merged). The function swallows a failed `gh issue edit --remove-label` and still returns 0, so the release marker gets posted anyway. On every later tick the dedupe check matches that marker and skips the latch removal.
  WHY: A single transient failure to remove the label on the release tick leaves `ai:needs-human` on a released security follow-up for good. This contradicts the changelog.d and agents.d promise that "On release the poller also removes the hold's own `ai:needs-human` latch". All reviewers rated it MAJOR.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:18637-18648, 18758-18801 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `write_standalone_state_json` swallows PATCH/POST failures with `|| true`, so a failed write leaves `escalated_ts` at 0. The marker_present branch of `_security_dependency_hold_age_check` then re-adds `ai:needs-human`, because it cannot tell a lost label edit from a person deliberately removing the label.
  WHY: After a failed state write, a label that a person removed gets re-added under `reason=security_dependency_escalated detail=marker_present`. This breaks the documented "Escalation is skipped when the label is present or escalated_ts is set" contract for that episode, and the log claims the escalation was recorded. All reviewers rated it NIT.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:18685-18690 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The header comment of `_security_dependency_hold_age_check` still says "Steady state (recorded, not yet due, or already escalated) makes no API call". The function now calls `unblock_trusted_login` (line 18717) first, which makes one cached `/user` read per tick.
  WHY: Nothing breaks at runtime. The comment contradicts the updated agents.d fragment and misleads §14 API-budget audits. All reviewers rated it NIT.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:run_standalone_stall_recovery, unmerged-release branch, lines 24184-24197, which call _security_dependency_clear_latch (lines 18807-18831) at line 24188. The same pattern is in the merged-release branch at lines 24207-24223, which calls clear_latch at line 24213. | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The latch is removed only when the release marker is missing. `_security_dependency_clear_latch` treats a failed remove-label as a warning and returns 0, so `/reclarify` is posted with the marker anyway. Later ticks match the dedupe check at 24185-24187 and never call clear_latch again. The merged path at 24213 behaves the same way.
  WHY: One remove-label failure on the release tick leaves a released follow-up labelled ai:needs-human for good, contradicting the changelog and agents.d fragments. Suggested fix: also call `_security_dependency_clear_latch ... || true` when the marker is already present (it is idempotent), or skip posting the marker when removal fails.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:_security_dependency_hold_age_check, header comment at lines 18689-18690 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `unblock_trusted_login` (line ~18717) now runs before the steady-state return and makes one cached `/user` read per tick, but the comment still says steady state makes no API call.
  WHY: Nothing breaks at runtime. The comment is wrong about the API budget that §14 audits rely on, and it contradicts the agents.d fragment.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:_security_dependency_hold_age_check marker_present branch (from about line 18759); write_standalone_state_json, lines 18642-18648 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: escalated_ts is written through write_standalone_state_json, which ignores PATCH/POST failures, and the caller still logs `reason=security_dependency_escalated`. If that write fails after the label lands, a person's later removal of the label gets reverted by the marker_present branch.
  WHY: This needs a failed state write first. It then breaks the "Escalation is skipped when the label is present or escalated_ts is set" contract for that episode.
- HARDENING_SUGGESTIONS (2 related items): retry clear_latch in the marker-present path at lines 24185-24197 and near 24207; reword the comment at lines 18689-18690. HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 2.
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

  WHY: If a transient remove-label failure happens on the release tick, later ticks match the release marker and never try to clear the label again, so `ai:needs-human` stays on the issue indefinitely.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:18770, 18801 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The marker_present branch re-adds `ai:needs-human` whenever the latch exists and `escalated_ts` is 0. A silently failed `write_standalone_state_json` leaves `escalated_ts` at 0.
  WHY: A label that a person removed is re-added with `reason=security_dependency_escalated detail=marker_present`, breaking the promise that a removed label stays removed.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:18689-18690 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The header comment wrongly says steady state makes no API call.
  WHY: `unblock_trusted_login` (line 18717) makes a cached `/user` call on every invocation. This contradicts the documentation and misleads API-budget checks.

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:24188 (unmerged-release marker-absent branch), 24213 (merged-release marker-absent branch), 18807-18827 (_security_dependency_clear_latch) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: clear_latch is called with `|| true` only in the marker-absent branch of both release paths. A remove-label failure at line 18822 is swallowed and the function returns 0, the release marker posts (line 24191 or 24218), and later ticks never call clear_latch again.
  WHY: The label can then only be removed by a person, contradicting agents.d/stuck-states-p8c-security-hold.md and changelog.d/stuck-states-p8c-security-hold.md. Suggested fix: also call the idempotent clear_latch when the label is present.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:18685-18690 (header comment of _security_dependency_hold_age_check), 18717 (unblock_trusted_login call inside the function body) | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The header comment still says steady state makes no API call, but `unblock_trusted_login` now runs at the top of the function and makes one cached `GET /user` per tick.
  WHY: Nothing breaks at runtime. The stale comment misleads anyone cross-checking the API budget against agents.md or §14.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:18770 (marker_present branch state write), 18800 (main escalation path state write) | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: `write_standalone_state_json` silently swallows PATCH/POST failures and returns 0. If escalated_ts is never written, the next tick logs `detail=marker_present` again, re-adds the label, and reverts a person's removal.
  WHY: This needs a failed state write (and optionally a person removing the label). It breaks the "Escalation is skipped when the label is present or escalated_ts is set" invariant for one episode and hides the incident from operators.
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
